/// Rasterisasi `text` menjadi posisi piksel relatif (skala `scale`).
pub fn rasterize(text: &str, scale: usize) -> Vec<(i32, i32)> {
    let mut pixels = Vec::new();
    let scale = scale.max(1);
    let mut pen = 0i32;
    for byte in text.bytes() {
        let character = byte.to_ascii_uppercase();
        let index = if (0x20..0x7F).contains(&character) {
            (character - 0x20) as usize
        } else {
            0
        };
        let glyph = &GLYPHS[index * 5..index * 5 + 5];
        for y in 0..7 {
            for x in 0..5 {
                if glyph[x] & (1 << (6 - y)) != 0 {
                    for sy in 0..scale {
                        for sx in 0..scale {
                            pixels.push((pen + (x * scale) as i32 + sx as i32, (y * scale) as i32 + sy as i32));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pen += (6 * scale) as i32;
    }
    pixels
}

/// Lebar teks dalam piksel pada skala tertentu (dipakai untuk perataan).
pub fn measure(text: &str, scale: usize) -> usize {
    if text.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    (text.len() * 6 - 1) * scale.max(1)
}

pub fn scale_for(font_size: f32) -> usize {
    (font_size / 9.0).round().max(1.0) as usize
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn empty_text_has_no_pixels() {
        assert!(rasterize("", 1).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(measure("", 1), 0);
    }
}
